judgments.reason: HEFMI-ICH Scientific Data paper describes this exact dataset: hybrid EEG-fNIRS MI, 17 healthy and 20 ICH patients (37 subjects), same authors and DOI as dataset.
judgments.paper_title: HEFMI-ICH: a hybrid EEG-fNIRS motor imagery dataset for brain-computer interface in intracerebral hemorrhage

judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiology data into BIDS, used in curating this dataset, not a paper describing the hybrid EEG-fNIRS ICH dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: EEG-BIDS is a data-organization standard extension that this BIDS-formatted dataset uses; it does not describe the hybrid EEG-fNIRS ICH motor imagery data.
judgments.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
